recordings.input: How does your daily pricing work?

parts.text: support

Our daily pricing relies on the net metal weight of the piece multiplied by the owner-confirmed daily rate for that purity. From there, each piece applies either a configured percentage of the metal value or a fixed making charge (with fixed charges taking precedence). Any applicable stone charges are added, followed by an illustrative tax on the subtotal. 

Please note that this is an independent portfolio demonstration with illustrative rules, not an official commercial shop. Quotes generated remain valid for 15 minutes and cannot be edited. Let me know if you would like to explore any pieces or have other questions!
